population: new synthetic curated challenge holdout; not random users, human study or release acceptance

common_gold.ambiguity: clarification_required; record alternatives, never guess capture/event or count as Recall success
common_gold.scope: current visible original with current authenticated manual metadata; no inferred occurrence, preference, entity or dates

routes.direct_keywords: independent question-only keyword plan through actual LocalOriginalSearchController and indexed SQL owner; never force raw-question paste as comparator
routes.assisted_confirmed: isolated question plus actual QuestionKeywordFragments proposals; explicit action plan replay through actual QuestionKeywordController, navigation gate, atomic canonical commit and same original search controller

metrics.macro_recall_at_5: mean over same resolved positive-gold questions; refusal/error/empty counts zero; unresolved and empty-gold separately listed
metrics.no_candidate_rate_end_to_end: READY with zero hits / all resolved questions
metrics.no_candidate_rate_ready_only: READY with zero hits / all actual READY questions
metrics.term_manual_edit_need_rate: prequery isolated assisted plans requiring term typing/deletion / all resolved questions; actual edits and unfinished separately; not minimum possible intervention
metrics.manual_date_entry: separate from term edits and mandatory date confirmation
metrics.empty_gold_false_returns: all returned IDs plus numerator/denominator; never Recall=1
metrics.all_unresolved_and_technical_failures: retain every planned question in flow table, never remove to improve score

execution.normal_suites_or_ci: UNCHANGED; do not rerun for this design
execution.calibration: non-holdout executor checks first; excluded from quality denominators

limitations: small constructed set, implementation and operator selection bias remain
agent independence does not imply independent human judgment
selection plans and human confirmation are not automatic extraction accuracy
no answer entailment or user-time claim
not complete D06, semantic search, five-type question assistance or device acceptance
real OCR, device audio, native SQLCipher device, TalkBack and performance NOT RUN
